latestVersion.changelog:
Free Free Text — Convert Text Into Videos (v1.0.0)

- Initial release: Convert text prompts, TXT, DOCX, and PDF files into 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPUs.
- Supports uploads up to 200MB; process time is typically 1–2 minutes per video.
- Simple onboarding: auto-generates free API token if needed, and manages sessions automatically.
- Actions include: video generation, uploads, export, viewing credits, checking session status, and timeline edits.
- Exports are free (no credits needed) and support various file formats.
- Comprehensive error handling and clear status updates for a smooth user experience.
